question: As per an announcement made by the Chairman of ISRO on 6 September 2021, Chandrayaan-2 had completed ______ revolutions of the Moon.
solution:
The correct answer is __**9000**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Chandrayaan 2 mission launched on **July 22, 2019,** from **GSLV (Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle) Mark-III** Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh.
 
• Chandrayaan 2 mission was the** 2nd lunar exploration mission** by the ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation) after Chandrayaan 1.
 
• Chandrayaan 2 mission comprised an **Orbiter, Lander - Vikram__ and Rover-__Pragyan__** to explore the unexplored **South Pole of the Moon**.
